candidates.description: This feature vector represents the concepts of visual perception, observation, and cognitive viewpoints.
This feature vector activates strongly on words related to motion pictures, filmmaking, and video media.
This vector activates for narrative genres, forms of storytelling, and fictional works.
This feature vector represents visual media and imagery, including photographs, videos, and artistic pictures.
This vector represents common transitive action verbs across various tenses and inflections.
This vector activates in contexts involving the action of bringing things into existence or bringing about change.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to positive evaluative adjectives and expressions of praise or high quality.
This feature vector activates strongly on words associated with superheroes, comic books, and epic fiction.
This feature vector activates on verbs of communication and assertion used to report speech, dialogue, or academic arguments.
Adverbs ending in "-ly" that modify verbs or adjectives to describe manner, degree, or state.
